docs.summary: A humanoid IK goal: the desired end effector transform plus how strongly position and rotation should be enforced. In a [`HumanPose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanPose) it is expressed in the current body frame, so it is rig independent.
The goal transform. Its position is the offset from the midpoint of the hip joints divided by the avatar scale, its rotation the hand or foot's anatomical frame, both in the body frame.
How strongly to drive the end effector to the goal position (0 = ignore, 1 = pin).
How strongly to drive the end effector to the goal rotation (0 = ignore, 1 = pin).
The mid joint (elbow/knee) bend hint, measured like the position of [`Transform`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Transform).
True if [`Pole`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanGoalState~Pole) holds a valid bend hint.
